season.short_description: Flu season of the estimate, written as 2024-25.
season.long_description: Season the cumulative flu estimate belongs to. Missing for RSV, which counts vaccines received since August 2023.

vaccine.short_description: Flu (seasonal influenza vaccine, beneficiaries 65+) or rsv (RSV vaccine, beneficiaries 75+ with Part D).
vaccine.long_description: Vaccine the estimate refers to. For flu, seasonal influenza vaccine received since August 1 of the season, among fee-for-service beneficiaries 65 and older. For rsv, RSV vaccine ever received since August 1, 2023, among fee-for-service beneficiaries 75 and older enrolled in a Part D drug plan (RSV vaccines are billed under Part D).

age.short_description: Age group of the beneficiaries: 65+ for flu, 75+ for RSV.
age.long_description: Age group of the beneficiaries: 65 and older for flu, 75 and older for RSV.

race_ethnicity.short_description: Race and ethnicity of the beneficiaries.
race_ethnicity.long_description: Race and ethnicity of the beneficiaries. Overall includes people with unknown race and ethnicity.

medicare_coverage.long_description: Cumulative percent of Medicare fee-for-service beneficiaries with a claim for the vaccine, estimated by CDC from CMS claims data. Medicare Advantage enrollees are not included.

cms_medicare.name: Medicare Fee-For-Service claims (CMS Chronic Conditions Warehouse)
cms_medicare.organization: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, analysed by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
cms_medicare.location: Weekly Cumulative Influenza (and RSV) Vaccination Coverage, by Race and Ethnicity, Medicare Fee-For-Service Beneficiaries (FluVaxView and RSVVaxView dashboards)
cms_medicare.description: CDC estimates vaccination coverage among Medicare fee-for-service beneficiaries from administrative claims in the CMS Chronic Conditions Warehouse. Weekly cumulative estimates are calculated with Kaplan-Meier survival analysis among beneficiaries enrolled as of August 1. They cover flu vaccines received since August 1 of each season among adults 65 and older, from the 2019-20 season, and RSV vaccines received since August 1, 2023 among adults 75 and older enrolled in a Part D plan. Estimates are national, by race and ethnicity, and reflect claims processed by the CMS data release date. Medicare Advantage enrollees are not included.
cms_medicare.restrictions: Public domain. CDC and CMS data are generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
